title: Airy Sweet Saudi Arabian Milk Pudding
description: A sweet and crispy Saudi Arabian dessert featuring sweetened condensed milk and laminated puff pastry, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sweetened condensed milk, beaten eggs, granulated sugar, rose water, and cardamom powder.
Brush the melted butter evenly over the puff pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Pour the milk mixture over the pastry, spreading it evenly to the edges.
Fold the 1 inch border of the pastry up over the filling to form a crust.
Brush the crust with a little bit of water and sprinkle with chopped pistachios if using.
Bake the pudding for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours before serving.
